Navigation can use approved in-app or external provider handoff while preserving authoritative trip state and preventing destination/token leakage.
phase0_note: Clarified: keep-awake/screen-on, call-overlay and glanceable UI while driving are part of M23 acceptance (CL-08).

title: Driver support surfaces digital help plus partner/field center location, hours and appointment/ticket linkage where centers exist.
Registered dashcam capability stores device/coverage metadata and notifies riders before trip where recording is lawful; footage handling is separate from routine telemetry.

Driver offer alerting while online: an active Driver/Partner session runs a policy-compliant location foreground service whose realtime socket/poll/recovery path is the primary offer channel; FCM high-priority or heads-up notifications on a dedicated offer channel are a wake/alert aid only and never authoritative trip state; server offer state is authoritative with missed-push recovery on reconnect; explicit OEM battery-optimisation/autostart guidance during driver onboarding; Android full-screen intent is not requested by default for ordinary ride offers and may be used only if a future Google Play policy review confirms eligibility, the driver explicitly grants it and graceful degradation exists.
phase0_note: Closure pass: push is a wake aid, not authoritative state; USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT is not requested by default (ADR-033).

title: Safety Center/Toolkit is a first-class passenger and driver surface before/during/after rides, grouping emergency, trusted contacts, share trip, report, support and safety settings.

Community Guidelines/code of conduct cover harassment, discrimination, violence, sexual misconduct, drugs/weapons, smoking, fraud, property damage, unsafe driving and account sharing with proportionate enforcement.
Blocking/no-rematch rules prevent future matching after approved safety block or severe rating/report while preserving appeals and avoiding disclosure of complainant details.
Trip anomaly detection evaluates unexpected long stop, major route deviation, implausible teleport/speed and suspicious premature completion and triggers a non-alarmist check-in/escalation.
Crash/sudden-impact detection may combine device/location signals but must expose uncertainty, avoid false emergency-dispatch claims and provide manual confirmation/escalation.
Discreet in-trip safety report can be filed without alerting the other party and is queued for post-trip or urgent handling based on severity.
Encrypted in-app audio recording is disabled until legal/privacy review; if enabled it has clear consent/notice policy, local protection, scoped upload/access, expiry and evidence handling.
Driver dashcam/audio-video recording has registration/notice, retention/access rules and jurisdiction review; riders are not secretly recorded by platform design.
Seat-belt and correct-vehicle reminders appear at appropriate trip stages without blocking genuine emergency use.

Emergency screen exposes current coordinates, driver/rider identity fields allowed by policy, vehicle plate/model and trip ID for user relay to Punjab Police 15/Rescue 1122 or other locality-specific services.
SOS accidental-trigger/cancel and unreachable-user procedures are defined; safety staff see event timestamps and failed-contact attempts.
Incident cases accept controlled photo/video/audio/document evidence with malware scanning, metadata minimization, retention and access audit.
Safety evidence has chain-of-custody/audit events, legal hold capability and immutable decision history appropriate to investigations and disputes.
Law-enforcement/regulator requests follow a documented lawful-request workflow, authorization review, minimum disclosure, logging and emergency exception policy; no informal employee disclosure.
Insurance/takaful claim intake links trip, people, vehicle, policy/coverage, incident evidence, provider case ID, status and appeal/contact without platform pretending to be insurer.
Before start, both parties can flag rider/driver/vehicle identity mismatch and terminate safely without unjust cancellation penalty.
Periodic vehicle photo/plate condition recheck can be risk- or schedule-triggered and routes uncertainty to review; it does not replace official fitness inspection.
Location-integrity controls detect mocked GPS, impossible movement, emulator/device tampering and stale positions as risk signals with human appeal; no single signal auto-bans.
Post-trip privacy redacts exact rider pickup/drop history from driver views except minimum information needed for current disputes, safety or legal obligations.
Contextual safety check-ins for unusually long/night/high-anomaly rides use transparent rules and can be dismissed; they are not covert behavioral surveillance.
Public-launch safety support coverage, escalation roster and response SLAs are published internally and staffed; pilot hours cannot be marketed as 24/7 unless actually staffed.
Minor/child policy defines who may ride, guardian responsibility, child-seat requirements and escalation for apparent unaccompanied minors.
Pet policy defines allowed animals/carriers, service-animal/accessibility treatment where applicable, allergies, cleaning and refusal rules.
Harassment/discrimination/sexual-misconduct reports have specialist severity rules, survivor-sensitive contact preferences, evidence minimization and anti-retaliation/no-rematch controls.
Unsafe-trip early termination supports safe stop, emergency escalation, fare/refund review, evidence and re-matching only when appropriate.
Pooling supports per-co-rider block/no-rematch and safety case linkage without revealing one rider’s identity/history to unrelated co-riders.
Safety transparency metrics define what can be published without exposing victims, gaming detection or making unsupported safety-superiority claims.
Driver background/security screening is performed only through lawful authorized sources/providers with re-screen policy, adverse-action notice and appeal where required.
Roadside breakdown flow protects riders/driver, marks trip state, rebooks/refunds as policy allows and links towing/assistance only through approved partners.
Lost-property workflow prevents direct address disclosure, limits communication windows, records custody/return and supports safety escalation for sensitive items.

Post-trip contact lockdown: masked communication channels expire at trip end (bounded lost-item window excepted), drivers cannot see rider drop-off/pickup after completion beyond dispute needs, and 'contacted me after the trip' is a first-class report reason routed to trust & safety.
Cash remains an explicit payment method with city/category eligibility, exact fare display, change guidance, driver collection responsibility and cash-fraud monitoring.
Card payments use a PCI-scoped PSP/hosted/tokenized flow; platform never stores raw PAN/CVV and verifies signed provider callbacks.
Provider-supported card authentication/tokenization such as 3-D Secure is handled through PSP contracts and tested for retries, abandonment and duplicate callbacks.
JazzCash merchant/wallet payment integration is a provider ADR with sandbox proof, merchant onboarding, signed callbacks, refunds and reconciliation before launch.
Easypaisa merchant/wallet payment integration is a provider ADR with merchant onboarding, callbacks, refunds and reconciliation before launch.
Raast P2M payment option is implemented only through an SBP-regulated bank/EMI/PSP/MSP, supporting the selected QR/RTP/alias/IBAN flow, confirmation, refund and reconciliation.
Additional regulated Pakistan wallets/banks can be plugged through the PSP abstraction without custom ride-state logic or unlicensed custody.
Saved payment methods are provider tokens with clear brand/last4/expiry display, default selection, removal and lost-device revocation.
Preauthorization/authorization/capture/void behavior is defined per payment method and trip lifecycle; retries are idempotent and never double-charge.
Failed/insufficient digital payment creates a controlled outstanding balance/retry/support flow; it never silently converts to cash after trip without disclosed policy.
Refunds return through original rail where possible, track pending/completed/failed statuses and have a documented cash-trip refund resolution.
Driver tips are optional, clearly separated in ledger/receipt/driver earnings and cannot alter ratings or service eligibility.
Waiting fee has free grace, server timer, cap, notification, evidence and appeal; safety-caused delays can be waived.
Toll, parking and airport/terminal charges are categorized, disclosed/reconciled and cannot be arbitrary free-text driver additions.
Cleaning/damage fee claims require timely evidence, policy caps, rider notice and appeal/maker-checker approval; no automatic card charge without valid authorization/policy.
Cancellation/no-show fees have actor/reason/timing rules, transparent estimate, waiver cases, payment capture and appeal.
Cash overpayment/shortpayment/change disputes create financial adjustments through ledger reversals/entries, not manual balance edits.
Driver platform-dues payment/top-up has provider reference, idempotency, reconciliation and account restoration rules.
Payout payee change/new bank or wallet requires step-up verification, cooling/risk control and audit before funds can be sent.
Tax/withholding/GST or other statutory fields are configuration-driven per legal advice and reflected on statements/invoices without inventing tax treatment.
Payment method availability can vary by city/category/rider risk and is server-authoritative; UI never offers an unavailable rail.
Chargeback/payment dispute workflow freezes only necessary amounts, preserves evidence and posts reversals/fees through ledger.
Voucher/gift credit is promotional liability, not withdrawable stored value, unless a licensed partner structure explicitly permits otherwise.
Digital-payment provider outage has a disclosed fallback/retry plan; switching to cash requires policy and both parties’ awareness rather than silent server behavior.
In-app rider/driver chat is trip-scoped, rate-limited, retained per policy, abuse-reportable and blocks attachments/links unless explicitly secured.
Masked call relay hides personal numbers where provider coverage exists and has honest outage/fallback behavior; raw phone number is not exposed by default.
Approved WhatsApp Business transactional/authentication templates may be used only via contracted provider and user-consent/Meta rules, with SMS/voice fallback for critical flows.
Email channel sends receipts, support updates and policy/account notices with verified domains, unsubscribe separation for marketing and no sensitive trip detail in subject lines.
SMS channel covers OTP and selected critical trip/support fallbacks with templates, language choice, sender registration/cost limits and anti-spam controls.
Communication preference center separates mandatory service/safety/account notices from optional marketing by channel and language.
Omnichannel support chat/ticket links authenticated customer, trip, payment and incident context without agents asking users to resend CNIC/payment secrets.
Help-center/CMS supports versioned Urdu/English content, searchable categories, city-specific policies, emergency separation and approval workflow.
Support knowledge base gives agents approved scripts/runbooks, decision trees, refund limits, escalation and change history.
Lifecycle CRM segmentation uses consented/non-sensitive attributes, frequency caps and suppression after complaints/opt-out.
Referral codes/invites have attribution, eligibility, budget, fraud detection, reward status and terms; self-referral/device farms are blocked.
Promo/voucher engine supports city/category/user/time caps, budget reservation, stackability rules, expiry and ledger treatment.
Install/deep-link attribution is privacy-aware and cannot let third-party SDKs ingest raw trip/CNIC/location history beyond approved purpose.
Lifecycle campaigns for onboarding, first ride, churn and driver activation are feature-flagged, measured and suppressible; safety/payment messages are never marketing experiments.
A/B experimentation platform uses assignment IDs, guardrail metrics, exposure logging and excluded safety/identity/financial invariants.
Remote config/kill switch can disable risky categories/providers/features per app version/city without changing historical trip/financial truth.
Outage/status communications provide in-app banner and support script; status claims come from monitored systems, not manual optimism.
Localized content management handles English, Urdu script and Roman Urdu copy with reviewed terminology and no machine-translation-only safety/legal text.
Post-trip satisfaction/NPS or surveys are separate from mandatory safety reports and cannot hide support access after a poor rating.
Corporate/partner bulk vouchers and campaign budgets have authorized issuer, spend controls, recipient eligibility and reporting.
Mobile auth/session secrets are stored only in OS secure storage/keychain/keystore; no tokens, CNIC or payment secrets in AsyncStorage/plain preferences/logs.
Android Play Integrity and Apple App Attest/DeviceCheck or equivalent are evaluated as risk signals for abuse-sensitive actions; unsupported devices have controlled fallback.
Root/jailbreak/emulator/debugger/tampering detection contributes to risk scoring but is not the sole permanent-ban or accessibility decision.
TLS, secure cookies/headers where applicable and modern transport settings are mandatory; certificate pinning requires an ADR for rotation/outage/recovery before use.
Internet-facing services have DDoS/WAF/bot/rate-limit controls at edge/API plus application-level per-user/device/IP/business-key limits.
Credential stuffing, OTP bombing, enumeration, scraping and automated fare/driver abuse have dedicated detection/limits and incident playbooks.
Secrets are held in managed secret storage or protected CI variables with owner, rotation, environment scope and leak-revocation runbook.
Encryption at rest/in transit and key-management responsibilities are documented for databases, backups, object storage, KYC evidence and analytics exports.
CI performs SAST, dependency/SCA, secret, container/image and IaC scans with severity policy and documented exception expiry.
Build pipeline emits dependency lockfiles/SBOM and signed/provenance-aware release artifacts sufficient to trace production binaries to reviewed source SHA.
Protected default branch requires CI/review policy, disallows casual force-push/history rewrite and records release tags/SHAs.
Android/iOS signing keys, app-store credentials and production provider secrets have least-privilege custody, backup/recovery and offboarding procedures.
Mobile releases use staged/percentage rollout, minimum-compatible API version, remote kill switches and rollback/stop procedures.
Backend deployments use health gates, backward-compatible rollout, drain/rollback and active-trip protection; deploy cannot strand rides midway.
DB/schema/API/event changes preserve N-1 mobile compatibility during rollout and use expand/migrate/contract or equivalent safe migration pattern.
Production infrastructure is defined reproducibly as code/config with environment review; one-off console changes are detected/documented.
Core user journeys have explicit SLIs/SLOs: auth/OTP, quote, match, driver location freshness, trip transition, payment ledger, support/safety ingestion and admin availability.
Synthetic monitoring continuously tests safe non-monetary or sandbox paths plus health/dependency probes from relevant geography.
Incident management defines severity, incident commander, on-call contacts, comms, containment, evidence, postmortem and follow-up ownership.
RPO/RTO targets exist for ride state, financial ledger, KYC evidence, support/safety data and analytics, with restore/DR exercises proving claims.
Encrypted backups are periodically restored into isolated environments and checked for application usability, not merely backup-job success.
Public/internal status page communicates material outages without leaking security-sensitive internals and links to incident communication process.
Servers, workers, DB and queue infrastructure use reliable time synchronization; financial/lease/OTP decisions never trust client device clock.
phase0_note: Clarified: all timestamps stored/computed in UTC; PKT (UTC+5, no DST) is presentation only (CL-09).

title: Data retention/archival schedule is implemented by category: precise location, messages, KYC/biometrics, payments, safety evidence, logs, analytics, support and legal holds.
High-volume driver/location history has partitioning/downsampling/TTL strategy; canonical trip evidence is separated from raw telemetry.
Performance budgets include mobile cold/warm start, map interaction, data usage, battery, API p95/p99, realtime reconnect and dispatch assignment latency.
Representative low-end Android devices and constrained memory/storage/network are first-class QA targets, not only flagship emulator testing.
Background location/push/battery behavior is tested across OEM battery savers, app kill, reboot, permission downgrade and network switching.
Accessibility regression tests cover screen reader, font scaling, contrast, focus order, motion reduction and critical safety/payment flows.
Localization regression covers Urdu RTL, Roman Urdu search/copy, truncation, numerals, PKR formatting, dates/times and mixed-direction map/address text.
Supported OS/app-version matrix and deprecation policy define minimum Android/iOS, forced/soft upgrade, backend compatibility and security exception handling.
Real-device release matrix includes passenger and driver scenarios, background GPS, camera/KYC, low signal, calls/messages, payment redirects and deep links.
Fault-injection/chaos tests cover map, SMS, push, Redis, DB replica/connection, PSP, object storage and realtime failures without corrupting trip or ledger truth.
Capacity model defines expected riders, drivers, location updates/sec, concurrent sockets, quote/match QPS, storage growth and cost before each rollout tier.
FinOps dashboard tracks cost per active rider/driver/trip by maps, messaging, compute, DB, storage, observability, KYC and payment provider with alerts.
Telemetry has default deny/redaction for CNIC, selfie/biometric, access tokens, card data, OTPs, full phone, precise long-term location and support attachments.
Analytics uses pseudonymous IDs/minimized fields and consent/retention policies; production raw tables are not copied to developer laptops.
Data warehouse/BI ingestion is downstream, replayable and access-controlled; it cannot become transaction truth or bypass deletion/retention requirements.
Privileged audit logs are append-only/tamper-evident enough to identify actor, action, object, before/after or reason, timestamp and request trace.
Coordinated vulnerability disclosure/security contact and intake SLA exist before public launch; a bug bounty is optional later after triage capacity exists.
Company domains and transactional email use SPF/DKIM/DMARC, controlled DNS/registrar access, TLS and anti-phishing monitoring/recovery.
Production admin access uses SSO/MFA, least privilege, device/network controls where feasible, short sessions, step-up for high-risk actions and offboarding tests.
Third-party/vendor risk register records data shared, credentials, region, SLA, sub-processors, pricing limits, incident contact, contract/DPA and exit/migration plan.
Data-location/cross-border inventory documents where rider/driver/KYC/payment/safety data is processed and flags legal/contract review before provider adoption.
Biometric/KYC privacy impact assessment is a launch gate covering necessity, alternatives, bias/error, retention, vendor access, breach response and appeals.
Privacy Center exposes policy versions, permissions, marketing choices, linked devices/providers, data requests and understandable location/identity explanations.
Data access/export/correction/deletion requests have identity verification, exclusions/legal holds, downstream propagation, deadlines and audited completion.
Every phase report includes exact branch/SHA/worktree status, commands/tests, CI links/status, migrations, screenshots/device evidence where relevant, known failures, costs and untested items.

Release artefact and distribution policy: Android production releases ship to Google Play as an Android App Bundle meeting current Google 64-bit, target-SDK and 16 KB page-size requirements, using AAB split delivery and an ABI set chosen from dependency compatibility and measured Pakistan device coverage (arm64-v8a required; armeabi-v7a included when dependencies support it and coverage justifies it; arm64-only only after explicit device/market evidence); signed internal APKs only for controlled testers; iOS ships as a signed production archive through TestFlight internal/external testing and App Store Connect production submission/release; the public website never distributes unofficial production APKs; build provenance links every Android and iOS binary to a reviewed commit SHA.
phase0_note: Closure pass: ABI set is evidence-based; Android build JDK 17 for the RN/Expo path; NDK version follows the supported Expo/RN/AGP combination that passes 16 KB checks.

title: Punjab TNC operating-license requirement and application/renewal evidence are explicit external launch blockers; the product cannot self-declare legal authorization.
external_blocker: Punjab TNC operating licence: official requirements via counsel/Transport Department; any incumbent licence status is SECONDARY_REPORT / NEEDS_OFFICIAL_RECONCILIATION

title: Per-driver/vehicle route-permit status, district/platform scope, issue/expiry and evidence are modelled and revalidated according to current Punjab rules before accepting rides.
phase0_note: Data model NOW; legal applicability EXTERNAL.

title: Vehicle fitness certificate status, inspection source/date/expiry and failures are modelled; expired/failed vehicles cannot go online.
Third-party/passenger insurance evidence and required coverage status are modelled by vehicle/service/city; claims contact is linked to incidents.
Vehicle token-tax/registration ownership or authorized-use evidence is captured where required by permit/onboarding rules and rechecked at renewal.
phase0_note: Clarified: must model Pakistan 'open-letter' (untransferred), bank-hypothecated and company-owned vehicles with authorised-use evidence (CL-10).

title: Driver licence category/endorsement, medical/training/background requirements are configurable by current regulation and cannot be bypassed by fleet/admin.
Regulator data-access/export capability is built only to the exact legally required fields/process, with authorization, audit, minimization and no permanently open backdoor.
Corporate legal entity, SECP/tax/NTN/bank/merchant onboarding dependencies are tracked as launch checklist items with owner/evidence/expiry.
Separate current passenger Terms, driver/partner agreement, privacy notice, biometric/KYC notice and Community Guidelines have versioned acceptance and policy-change communication.
Fleet/vehicle-owner agreement, corporate-customer terms, courier/freight terms and pooling/women-service terms are separate when those verticals activate.
Cancellation/refund/no-show/waiting/damage/lost-property policies are publishable, city/version aware and match actual backend calculations.
Transport, privacy/biometric, payments, consumer, tax, insurance and worker/contractor legal review is a real-human launch gate; Claude output is not legal clearance.
Launch runbook defines pilot geofence, hours, eligible vehicles, driver count, support/safety staffing, payment modes, rollback/stop criteria and emergency contacts.
Driver supply launch plan covers sourcing, identity/document vetting, training, vehicle checks, activation, support center and no-show/quality remediation before consumer marketing.
Passenger support launch plan covers authenticated help, phone/in-app channels, safety escalation, lost items, refunds, payment issues, queue monitoring and staffing capacity.
Support QA audits sampled cases for policy accuracy, privacy, tone, escalation and unauthorized refunds/data disclosure with coaching and correction.
Operations staffing forecast is tied to active rides/drivers, incidents, KYC backlog and support contacts rather than assuming software replaces people.
Manual booking/agent console can create, modify or cancel rides only after caller verification and with actor/reason audit; agents cannot override driver compliance or money invariants.
Manual operational intervention in live trip/assignment is extremely limited, permissioned, reason-coded and cannot silently rewrite completed financial or safety history.
Driver field/support center operations track appointments, identity, document resubmission, training and complaint tickets without local spreadsheets becoming source of truth.
Marketing/brand launch covers trademark/name/domain/social-handle checks, original visual system, app-store creative, review-response process and crisis communication.
App-store operations cover legal entity, privacy labels/data safety forms, background-location justification, account deletion, reviewer demo accounts and staged release notes.
Marketplace health scorecard includes request-to-match, pickup ETA, completion, rider/driver cancellation, no-driver rate, driver utilization, earnings/hour, retention and geographic supply gaps.
Safety scorecard includes incident rate/severity, SOS/check-in outcomes, mismatch, spoof/fraud, support response and repeat-offender controls without incentivizing under-reporting.
Financial scorecard includes gross bookings, net revenue, driver payable, promo burn, payment success, refund/chargeback, cash receivable, payout/reconciliation breaks and unit economics.
Customer experience scorecard includes rating distribution, complaints, support resolution, accessibility/low-data failures and cohort retention; metrics are segmented without discriminatory pricing.
City expansion uses a repeatable regulatory/supply/operations/map/payment/safety readiness checklist; Lahore approval never automatically authorizes another city/province.
Service catalogue explicitly models Economy, Comfort, Bike, Rickshaw and later XL/Pet/Kids/accessible variants as separate eligibility/pricing/safety configurations rather than UI labels only.
phase0_note: Catalog model NOW (car first); additional classes activate by phase/gate.

title: Delivery/courier models sender/recipient verification, item description/size/photo, prohibited goods, pickup/delivery OTP or proof, failed delivery, return, insurance and disputes.
COD delivery is disabled until cash custody, merchant/recipient fraud, proof, remittance, limits and legal/accounting model are approved.
Cargo/freight models vehicle/body/load constraints, loaders if offered, quote/negotiation, commercial permits, proof and damage/dispute workflow separately from passenger rides.
Intercity models route/permit/insurance, scheduled or negotiated departure, luggage, stops, driver fatigue, passenger guarantee where required and breakdown/emergency handling.
Corporate/business portal supports organization verification, admins, users/guests, ride policy, cost centers, scheduled rides, approval, monthly invoice, tax/reporting and support.
Fleet/vehicle-owner portal supports owner/KYB, drivers, vehicles, assignments, compliance, earnings/settlement, permissions and cannot activate noncompliant supply.
Women-focused and pooled services remain independent feature flags with dedicated supply thresholds, consent, eligibility, safety, finance and rollback gates rather than marketing-only modes.
University/office commute pools support verified community, recurring schedules, seat reservation, bounded stops/detours, no public member directory and institution escalation contacts.
Family Safety Hub can let a consenting rider share selected trip status/history with trusted family/guardian without exposing unrelated trips or permanently sharing precise location.
Food/grocery/merchant marketplace is a separate future business with merchant catalog/order/refund/food-safety operations and is not smuggled into ride V1.
phase0_note: Explicitly excluded from ride V1 by requirement text.

title: Founder/company decision register assigns every plausible feature one status: NOW, LATER, OUT-OF-SCOPE or EXTERNAL-DECISION; nothing remains merely implied in prose.
phase0_note: Satisfied by this Phase 0 coverage artifact; maintained thereafter.

title: Canonical documentation rule: one authoritative PRD/requirements register/phase plan/ADR set; superseded docs are clearly archived, not allowed to conflict silently.
phase0_note: Phase 0 removes duplicate roadmaps (root duplicates DUP-01).

title: Repository safety rule: inspect branch/HEAD/worktree/remotes/CI/identity before change; no unauthorized force-push/amend/history rewrite and no AI co-author trailers.
Docker/data safety rule: never prune unknown volumes or factory-reset/delete persistent state without explicit authorization and verified backup/ownership.

Claude-only engineering rule: Claude plans/implements/self-audits; ChatGPT reviews reports and actual GitHub evidence when available; sensitive public-launch assurance still requires qualified humans.
Phase gate rule: accepted green work is not reopened or refactored without regression/evidence; next phase starts only from current repo truth and current canonical docs.
No real CNIC/selfie/payment secrets/API keys/auth-session files are put in prompts, issues, demo fixtures, commits or copied between machines; use synthetic licensed test data.

Punjab-specific compliance artefacts are modelled per driver/vehicle with issue/expiry/evidence: Punjab Police character certificate, PSCA QR panic-button installation, per-district per-platform route permit (Section 44B), VICS fitness, third-party insurance (MIR-linked) and token tax; dispatch checks district coverage for cross-district trips; all configurable per city and revalidated at go-online.

Harassment-complaint governance kit (Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010 / FOSPAH): inquiry-committee records, displayed code of conduct, exportable complaint register retained 3 years, regulator-response playbook with 7-day turnaround, linked to N24 case handling.

Driver acceptance and post-accept cancellation metrics are calculated transparently with excluded uncontrollable cases, appeal context and no coercive punishment for declining unsafe or unsuitable requests
Driver inbox/activity center consolidates document-expiry, trip/support, policy, payout, incentive and safety messages with read state, deep links and retention
Round-trip/return booking creates explicit outbound and return legs or a clearly defined waiting/return contract with separate pricing, timing, cancellation and driver-consent rules
Rider can separate personal and business ride profiles with distinct payment methods, work email/receipt routing, cost center or memo fields and privacy boundaries
Corporate/authorized guest ride can serve a rider without the consumer app using verified phone/SMS or secure web trip status, while preserving consent, safety access and support
Delegate/assistant booking supports role-scoped trip management and three-way rider/driver/delegate communication without exposing unrelated account data
Corporate/partner ride API and webhooks, if offered, use scoped credentials, idempotency, quotas, signed callbacks, audit and the same compliance/dispatch/ledger invariants as first-party apps
Business expense export/integration supports approved CSV/API/provider workflows, receipt reconciliation and employee privacy without making external expense systems transaction truth
Multi-drop courier batching models ordered stops, capacity, per-parcel custody/proof, route changes, partial failure, returns and driver workload rather than treating a batch as one parcel
Support/booking call recording or transcription, if used, requires notice/consent or other lawful basis, access controls, retention, redaction and explicit exclusion from unrelated model training
Push notification device-token lifecycle handles rotation, reinstall, logout, invalid tokens, multi-device targeting and permission-disabled states without leaking another user’s ride notifications
Recycled/reassigned phone-number risk has account-recovery and takeover protections so a new SIM owner cannot silently inherit a previous rider/driver account or sensitive trip history
Phone/Google/Apple account-link collisions and duplicate-account merge requests use step-up proof, conflict-safe rules, immutable audit and manual recovery instead of auto-merging identities
Trusted-contact selection minimizes contacts access by manual entry or platform contact picker where feasible; broad address-book upload is not required for core safety sharing
App-store rating/review prompts occur only after appropriate non-safety user moments, respect platform rules/frequency limits and never block support or manipulate ratings
Driver vehicle-display integrations such as Android Auto/CarPlay are evaluated only after core driver safety UX is stable, with limited distraction and no trip-state divergence
Driver road-hazard/map issue reporting, if introduced, is moderation/quality controlled and cannot become authoritative routing or safety truth without provider validation
Optional preferred/favorite-driver repeat matching is privacy- and fairness-reviewed, mutual/consent-based, non-exclusive and cannot bypass driver availability, eligibility or safety blocks
Optional priority-pickup product, if introduced, has transparent fee/eligibility and dispatch fairness rules and never promises a guaranteed pickup time without operational evidence
Flexible-pickup or wait-and-save product, if introduced, clearly trades pickup time for price, preserves accessibility/safety and never silently downgrades an immediate booking
Navigation route preferences such as avoid tolls/highways or accessibility constraints are provider-validated, disclosed to both parties where relevant and repriced consistently
Driver can select among approved navigation providers or in-app navigation without exposing private trip tokens/contacts or changing server-authoritative route/trip state

Airport/scheduled transfer can optionally store airline/flight/terminal metadata and provider-derived delay updates with freshness labels; flight data never silently changes a paid booking without policy

No-driver recovery offers only truthful alternatives such as retry, different eligible category, later schedule or approved nearby pickup; it never fabricates supply or auto-books a materially different service

Notification-category and OS-permission UX distinguishes mandatory in-app safety/service state from optional push/marketing, explains disabled notifications and provides safe fallback for critical events

Telecom-outage / internet-shutdown continuity: call-centre booking and SMS/voice trip details keep essential service running during mobile-data shutdowns, driver trip completion tolerates prolonged offline periods, and ops has a documented degraded-mode playbook.

Founder/company IP chain-of-title is documented: code, designs, domains, trademarks, contractor work and third-party assets are owned or licensed by the correct legal entity before fundraising/public launch
Company maintains an accurate cap table/share register, founder ownership and authorized issuance records; product repositories and commercial accounts are not substitutes for legal ownership records
If cofounders or new equity holders are added, founder/cofounder vesting, roles, reserved matters, leaver/deadlock and IP/confidentiality terms are documented by qualified counsel
Employees/contractors/consultants handling code, support, KYC or operations sign appropriate confidentiality, IP, acceptable-use, privacy/security and role agreements before access
Personnel joiner/mover/leaver process provisions least-privilege access, MFA, training and rapid offboarding across GitHub, cloud, stores, support, finance, social and physical systems
Company credential inventory and approved password/secrets management cover registrar, email, GitHub, cloud, app stores, PSP, telecom, social and emergency recovery with no shared personal passwords
phase0_note: Credential inventory starts Phase 1 (GitHub, cloud, domains).

title: Company-managed laptop/phone/admin-device asset inventory records owner, encryption, screen lock, patch level, loss response and secure disposal for devices with production or customer-data access
Bookkeeping/chart-of-accounts and month-end close reconcile bank, PSP, driver payable, cash commission receivable, taxes, payroll/contractors, promotions, refunds and provider costs with evidence

Tax/compliance calendar tracks applicable FBR, PRA or other provincial/federal registration, filing, invoicing and withholding obligations with qualified accountant/legal ownership and no hard-coded invented tax rules
Operating budget and rolling runway forecast separate one-time launch, fixed monthly, per-trip variable, support/safety, legal/insurance and marketing costs with scenario and cash-buffer assumptions
Procurement/vendor onboarding requires business owner, pricing/budget approval, security/privacy review when relevant, contract/data terms, credentials ownership and documented replacement/exit path
Vendor renewal/SLA/expiry calendar tracks maps, SMS, KYC, PSP, hosting, insurance, support telephony, domains/certificates and licenses so silent expiry cannot disable live trips
Business continuity plan covers loss of key staff, office/driver-center outage, telecom/vendor failure, banking/PSP interruption and crisis communications in addition to technical disaster recovery

Company insurance matrix is reviewed for transport/ride liability plus any applicable cyber, employer/worker, office, professional/general liability or other exposures; marketing claims match actual policies

Board/shareholder/founder governance records material decisions, authorized signatories, reserved approvals and conflicts of interest as the company evolves; chat messages alone are not corporate authorization

Fundraising data room, when fundraising begins, contains verified cap table, incorporation/tax, IP chain, contracts, security/privacy, financials, KPIs and risks without exposing unrestricted rider/driver personal data
Physical driver/onboarding/support centers have staff identity, visitor/access controls, document handling, CCTV/recording policy where lawful, secure disposal and incident reporting

Anti-bribery, conflict-of-interest and fraud controls cover driver approval, vehicle inspection, refunds, payouts, promo issuance, vendor selection and manual account reinstatement with reporting/escalation

Any office/field cash collection has custody limits, receipts, dual control/reconciliation, safe storage/deposit and shortage/robbery procedure; avoid cash handling where regulated digital alternatives are practical
Formal customer/driver complaint escalation covers internal appeal, consumer/regulator/legal escalation and evidence retention without suppressing safety reports or retaliating against complainants
Brand/social/app-store/domain accounts are company/founder controlled with MFA, recovery, publishing approval and impersonation/takedown process
Crisis communications names an accountable spokesperson and approval path for serious safety, outage, breach, regulatory or misinformation events; public claims are evidence-based and privacy-safe

Support/safety workforce hiring, background/confidentiality where justified, training, quality calibration, wellbeing, schedules and escalation coverage are capacity-planned before advertised service hours

Segregation-of-duties/maker-checker rules apply to high-risk refunds, payout-account changes, manual ledger adjustments, KYC overrides, promo grants, production access and other financially/safety sensitive actions

Legal/policy change register has owner and review cadence for transport, tax, payments, app-store, privacy, telecom, employment/contractor and insurance rules; affected features are re-gated before deadlines

Independent qualified penetration test or equivalent external security assessment gates any controlled public-facing real-user pilot for auth/KYC/admin/payment/location surfaces, with remediation and retest of critical findings before public launch
Real-user accessibility and usability audit includes riders/drivers with representative needs and low-end devices; automated checks alone do not approve critical booking/safety/payment journeys
Open-source and third-party license inventory/SBOM records license obligations, notices, redistribution/source requirements and prohibited/incompatible use before release

Mobile/web third-party SDK inventory maps data collected, purpose, permissions, network endpoints, subprocessors and store disclosure/privacy-manifest requirements; unapproved SDK data collection blocks release

Permission-minimization review covers location, background location, camera, microphone, photos/files, contacts, notifications and Bluetooth/nearby if ever used; each request is just-in-time and core-purpose justified

Account deletion implementation satisfies both in-app initiation and required web/request path/store disclosures, while clearly documenting lawful fraud/safety/financial retention exceptions and downstream deletion
Compromised or policy-violating third-party SDK/provider has remote disable/removal and credential-revocation runbook that preserves core trip safety where possible

Privileged support/admin workstations follow baseline controls such as OS patching, disk encryption, screen lock, approved browser/extensions, malware protection and restricted local export of production data

Personal-data/security breach response assesses containment, credential rotation, evidence preservation, affected processors/users/regulators/partners and legally required notification with approved communications

Public bug-bounty program is enabled only after vulnerability intake, ownership, safe-harbor terms, triage capacity and remediation SLAs exist; a security contact/vulnerability disclosure channel comes first

Dispatch, pricing, incentives, fraud/risk and ranking algorithms have documented objectives, inputs, protected invariants, monitoring, manipulation/feedback-loop risks and fairness/appeal review before high-impact automation
phase0_note: Documentation of dispatch/pricing objectives lands with Phase 4/5 code; fairness review before Phase 8.

title: Any ML model introduced for ETA, fraud, risk, identity or demand has versioned training/evaluation provenance, offline/online metrics, drift/rollback and human escalation appropriate to impact
Analytics/event/data contracts define owner, schema version, meaning, quality checks and deletion/retention classification so dashboards do not silently reinterpret business or safety metrics
API security testing includes schema fuzzing/property tests and abuse/replay/concurrency cases for high-risk state transitions beyond ordinary happy-path integration tests

Release go/no-go checklist explicitly aggregates product, real-device, CI, security, privacy, finance, legal/vendor, support/safety staffing, backups/rollback and city supply evidence; code-green alone cannot authorize launch
App-store policy watch tracks future effective requirements, including Google Play permission/location/contacts changes and Apple privacy/account rules, with owner/deadline and release impact

Store-review package maintains accurate demo/reviewer access, declarations, data-safety/privacy labels, background-location justification, account-deletion links and screenshots that match actual enabled functionality
Supported API/OS/provider versions have deprecation/end-of-life calendar, user communication, migration plan and emergency exception handling before upstream support ends

Cross-functional game day periodically exercises a severe outage or safety/communications/business-continuity scenario and records gaps/actions; tabletop success is not silently treated as production failover proof

Completeness closure rule: any newly discovered competitor feature, edge case, legal dependency, abuse mode or founder requirement is added to the canonical register with disposition before implementation; nothing may remain only in chat/prose
phase0_note: Operationalised by docs/26 and the Phase 0 coverage artifact; CI check proposed in guardrails (GR-05).

title: Wayvro ships as one public mobile application/store product for passengers and earning partners; one account can use Rider mode and, after approved onboarding, Driver/Partner mode without installing a second Wayvro app.
phase0_note: Founder-locked.

title: A single identity account may contain distinct rider and driver/partner profiles/capabilities; the server, not the UI mode switch, authorizes role-specific actions and data access.

Driver/partner application, CNIC/selfie/liveness/document onboarding, approval, training, suspension and re-verification occur inside the unified Wayvro app while normal rider access remains available unless an account-wide safety/legal restriction applies.

Mode switching obeys server-enforced conflict rules: a user cannot accept/serve driver work while participating in an incompatible active rider trip, cannot switch away from an active driver obligation in a way that abandons it, and active-state recovery after crash/restart is deterministic.

Sensitive permissions are requested just-in-time by mode and task; rider-only use does not trigger driver background-location/navigation/KYC permissions, and denial/revocation has an explicit recovery path.

Driver background services, location streaming, foreground-service indicators and high-frequency telemetry initialize only when justified by driver onboarding/online/active-trip state and stop reliably when the driver goes offline, signs out, is suspended or no longer has a lawful purpose.

Role-scoped histories, ratings, trust signals, earnings/settlement, payment instruments, documents, support cases and notifications are isolated by authorization policy so rider and driver data cannot leak across modes or staff boundaries.

The unified app has explicit mode-aware navigation, home surfaces, deep-link routing, notification routing, state restoration and back-stack rules so Rider and Driver/Partner workflows never land in the wrong context.

Driver/Partner mode supports service-capability and vehicle selection (for example car, bike, rickshaw, courier/delivery where approved) without creating duplicate accounts; eligibility is checked per city, vehicle and service before going online.

Unified-app releases require a cross-mode regression matrix: rider changes cannot silently break driver/KYC/background-location flows and driver changes cannot degrade booking, payments or rider safety; risky capabilities have mode-scoped feature flags/kill switches.
phase0_note: Cross-mode regression harness scaffolded in Phase 3 (first dual-mode screens) and enforced from Phase 4.

title: Startup time, memory, battery, binary size and low-end Android performance budgets protect rider users from driver-only complexity; expensive driver modules/providers/background workers are not initialized until needed and are profiled on representative devices.
Analytics, crash reporting, SLOs and support diagnostics segment Rider mode, Driver/Partner mode, onboarding state, service capability and app version without exposing unnecessary sensitive data.

Role-specific restriction semantics are explicit: driver suspension/expired documents may block earning while preserving lawful rider use; severe fraud/safety/legal actions may be account-wide; every transition is reason-coded, auditable and appeal-aware.

The single store listing/privacy disclosures accurately explain its multi-role nature and permission use; driver-only background location, camera/document and notification behavior is disclosed and reviewed against current Google Play/Apple policy before release.

Public website information architecture: home, how it works, rider and driver pages, cities/service areas, fare explanation, safety & trust centre, legal, help/support, careers/press, contact and corporate/fleet lead-in, managed through a CMS with approval workflow and versioning.
Web accessibility and performance: public and booking web surfaces meet WCAG 2.2 AA, Core Web Vitals budgets on low-end/3G devices, and English/Urdu/Roman-Urdu parity with the app.
Driver-signup web lead capture collects minimal contact details and consent, hands off to in-app onboarding via deep link/SMS, and never collects CNIC, selfie or documents through public web forms.

Official-channel and anti-impersonation surface: published list of official domains, app identifiers, phone numbers and social handles; a 'verify this is Wayvro / verify this ride' page; phishing and fake-app reporting channel; store-only app distribution links.

Legal and policy pages (terms, privacy, biometric/KYC notice, community guidelines, cancellation/refund policies) are hosted on the public web as the canonical versioned, dated location linked from the app, store listings and consent flows, with a change log.
Web analytics, SEO and consent: privacy-aware analytics, consent banner where required, structured data/sitemaps, and no third-party trackers that ingest personal or trip data.

Staff operations web application baseline: responsive and keyboard-accessible shell, MFA-backed sessions with idle lock and short lifetimes, reason-for-access prompts on PII views, approval-gated bulk exports, environment/audit banners and no client-side authorisation decisions.

Web infrastructure security and operations: commercial hosting plan (never non-commercial/hobby tiers), CSP/HSTS/secure headers, registrar/DNS custody, uptime monitoring, CMS access control, backups and a deploy pipeline isolated from the API.

Web booking and trip-status hardening (extends L09): phone-verified web sessions, bot/abuse controls, scoped short-lived trip-status tokens, no map-provider key leakage, and parity of safety/support entry points with the app.
